title: Critical strip-crossing mass on the honeycomb lattice
summary: At the critical weight of the regular honeycomb lattice, the total weight of self-avoiding paths crossing a strip of height N is comparable to N −1/4 . The first horizontal-displacement moment of return paths is comparable to N 3/4 .
family_title: The three-quarter exponent for honeycomb self-avoiding walk

review.reason: Estimates the critical weight of self-avoiding paths crossing a strip on the honeycomb lattice.
